verdict.rationale: The docs state that stagewise runs multiple agent instances in parallel, each with its own chat session and model (stagewise-docs-19). A 'keep the app awake while agents work' setting suggests some support for longer unattended runs (stagewise-docs-26), and agents can orchestrate multi-step workflows (stagewise-docs-25). However, this is a local desktop IDE with per-chat agents, and nothing shows fleet-scale autonomous execution lasting hours or days. Missing for 10: fleet-level launch and management of many agents, evidence of autonomous runs lasting hours or days, background or cloud execution independent of the desktop app, per-task isolation such as separate branches or worktrees, and independent hands-on corroboration of parallel agent use.
